responsibility: Node-local Agent integration writer: provider inspection, enable and disable plans, and their bounded filesystem and process effects using the cohort-admitted observation-adapter capsule, whose source it owns, with cooperative termination and one invocation budget. Its actual consumers are orchbee-worker, whose job owner runs it for the local Session, and orchbee, which reuses its read-only configuration helpers for offline agent doctor and Windows update verification.
nonGoals: Defining the operation contract, the provider registry, transport, authorization, rendering, or CLI grammar.
Owning Agent session state or observation ingress.
